prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: ONE production character model-sheet atlas for CrossNext Reading Adventure, a grayscale e-reader RPG.
Primary request: Redesign the six human hero examples in the same smooth friendly grayscale cartoon language as the PET reference. Image 1 (Silva atlas) is the STYLE reference only, do not copy its animal anatomy. Images 2 and 3 (small male and female apprentice sprites) are IDENTITY AND COSTUME references for the first pair; preserve their human character identity and short tunic, belt, boots, brown/dark swept hair, friendly large eyes. Replace pixel art with smooth confident black contours and flat white/light-gray/mid-gray/dark-gray fills.
Layout: a single transparent PNG atlas, exactly THREE columns by TWO rows, six well-separated full-body figures. Row 1 all male variants; row 2 all female variants. Column 1: Apprentice, plain lace-neck light tunic, broad dark belt, dark trousers and simple boots. Column 2: reading mage, pointed hat, open short robe and one closed journal held by hip, small star clasp. Column 3: celestial reader, elegant light armor, cape, restrained crescent-shaped shoulder details, small book clasp, no giant wings or aura. All six have the SAME head/body proportions, same full-body height, same relaxed standing pose, centered in own equal grid cell, feet on identical baselines within each row. Roughly 2.8 heads tall, slightly rounded hands and boots, friendly young adult chibi proportions with clean expressive human faces. Male short swept hair; female medium length hair with one side fringe; equal dignity and comparable costume coverage.
Style: match the smooth organic contour quality of the PET reference, black outline about 1.5% of figure height, generous clean surfaces, 4 gray values plus white and black, restrained flat cel shading, no gradients. At small native 128x208 sizes the face and costume must read immediately.
Transparent background, opaque white interiors. No text, letters, numbers, labels, UI, panel lines, grid lines, ground, scenery, cast shadows, dithering, hatching, pixelated or stepped outlines, glossy 3D rendering, tiny filigree or extra objects. Safe 12% empty margin around every figure. Keep silhouettes fully separated for atlas extraction.
Updated priority: the outer contour of every human must be BLACK and smooth as in the current attached PET screenshots. The outline must remain stronger than all interior gray shading. This sheet contains characters ONLY: no aura or animal. Match their humane friendly illustrated feel, and the same clear faces.
name: heroes-approved
